high_level_description: The image depicts a street scene in Valencia, Spain, following a devastating flood that occurred the previous day. The street is lined with tall buildings on both sides, creating a narrow corridor. The road is heavily congested with numerous vehicles, many of which appear to be submerged or piled up, indicating the extent of the flooding. In the foreground, a person wearing a red jacket is walking away from the camera, providing a sense of scale to the scene. The water level is high, reaching up to the lower parts of the parked cars, and some vehicles are partially submerged.
